$comment: React advisories that reach Next.js apps through the React copy compiled into the next package (next/dist/compiled). Lockfile scanners only see next, so check-next-bundled-react.mjs evaluates these against the installed next tree. See docs/testing/dependency-scanning.md.

advisories.summary: React Server Components remote code execution via crafted typed-array payloads
advisories.fixMarkerNote: next 16.4.0 and 16.4.6 both report React 19.3.0-canary-278794d7-20261002, but only 16.4.6 carries the fix, so the version string cannot decide. The minified server.browser.production.js builds encode the message and are excluded; they are not loaded by next start.
